entities.summary: Robert Loe is a New Zealand professional basketball player for the New Zealand Breakers of the Australian National Basketball League (NBL). He is also contracted with the Auckland Tuatara of the New Zealand National Basketball League (NZNBL). He played college basketball for Saint Louis University and has played in the Australian NBL since 2016. Since 2022, he has played for the Auckland Tuatara of the New Zealand NBL. He represents the New Zealand national team but also holds a British passport.
